A '''stonecrafter's workshop''' is where [[cv:Stone_crafter|stonecrafters]] create [[cv:stone|stone]] furniture from stone [[cv:block|blocks]]. This includes items that cannot be made by the [[cv:Mason%27s_workshop|mason's workshop]] such as [[cv:bed|beds]], [[cv:bin|bins]], [[cv:barrel|barrels]] and [[cv:bucket|buckets]]. A small selection of [[cv:Magma-safe|magma-safe]] objects are also available.

==Common Uses==
* Construct stone beds, not normally available to be made out of stone.
* Construct magma-safe blocks and furniture from those blocks, useful in magma traps and on [[cv:volcano|volcano]] embarks.
* Construct stone bins and barrels for item storage, useful when wood supplies are low.

==Notes==
* This workshop can be extremely effective when paired with the mass-produced concrete from a [[slag pit]] or [[brick]]s from a [[brick oven]].
* The hotkeys {{K|b}}, {{K|d}}, {{K|h}}, {{K|r}}, and {{K|u}} are listed as being used twice. Using these keys creates the items first listed with the hotkey in the menu (for example, {{K|b}} creates armor stands, not magma-safe blocks).
